'''David Willis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Westerville tournament]] on 30 June 2001 with Slave Quarters/Podracing start, according to Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2555">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01d2555/ columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01d2555/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
